newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech c.bank liquidity bill gross yield hits 16pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech c.bank liquidity bill gross yield hits 16pct.

text.p: Gross yield at the Czech central bank's (CNB) auction of a three billion crown tranche of 13-week liquidity bills was the maximum limit 16 percent, the CNB said in a statement on Thursday.
The auction price of the bills was 961,125 crowns for a one million crown bill, putting net yield at 12.0 percent.
The CNB said the auction was under-subscribed, with bids totalling 1.418 billion crowns, all of which were accepted.
The three-month Prague interbank offered rate (PRIBOR) stood at 17.07 percent on Thursday, down from 16.37 on Wednesday.
